title: Chapter 50: Meaning of the Number
html:
From the right angle, Chen Ge could make it out clearly: the Arabic numeral 2.

There was nothing frightening about the number by itself. In the aftermath of everything else, however, it felt unmistakably ominous.

Last night, after the shadow disappeared, the broken mirror showed a3. Now it has become2. Why is it counting down?Chen Ge had no answer.Is it actually a countdown?

He leaned against the doorway, staring at the mark while he tried to impose logic on something that refused to behave logically.

The mirror entity seemed to have left with Zhang Peng, so why leave this behind unless it plans to return?

It was only a theory. Chen Ge still knew far too little about the other side to trust any conclusion.

And what happens when the number reaches zero?

A bad feeling settled in his stomach as he paced outside the bathroom.I am not going to assume it is counting down my life just because that is what a horror movie would do.

He forced himself to stop spiraling.If another number appears tomorrow night, then I will know it is a pattern. Until then, guessing will only make me panic.

All Chen Ge had ever wanted was to preserve the Haunted House his parents had left him and, if possible, make it successful again. Somehow, that simple goal had accumulated an unreasonable number of supernatural complications.

By the time he returned to the staff room, several police vehicles were outside. Investigators from the city team asked him additional questions, documented the scene, and then joined the search for Zhang Peng.

Inspector Lee stayed with Chen Ge for a while. Even after sunrise, however, Zhang Peng had not been found. The officer assured him that the search was continuing and that Chen Ge should contact the police immediately if he saw anything suspicious.

Zhang Peng was not the part troubling Chen Ge most. His thoughts kept returning to the number on the mirror. Inspector Lee mistook his silence for shock from the break-in and did his best to reassure him before leaving with the others.

Alone again, Chen Ge opened the window and let the cool morning air wash over his face.

I own a Haunted House. Shouldn’t that make me the one frightening other people? Why am I the one getting haunted?

Morning light filtered into the room. The rag doll on the bed shifted in the breeze and tumbled to the floor.

Chen Ge picked it up and poked its round stomach. “The only specter who reliably listens to me is also the one who looks most like she needs protecting.”

The doll seemed to object. It wriggled faintly in his hand, which only made the complaint less convincing.

Both Nightmare Missions gave me support abilities. Useful for the Haunted House, yes, but not exactly a solution when something comes after me personally.

Whatever the countdown meant, Chen Ge refused to sit quietly and let an unknown force dictate what happened next.

He opened the black phone and reviewed every option. His strongest known supernatural ally remained Zhang Ya, the Red Specter. At the hut behind Ping An Apartments, she had warned him about Wang Qi’s presence and arguably saved his life.

On the other hand, she had not intervened during Deep Water. Her concern for Chen Ge’s safety was, at best, selective.

Completing her Bloody Heart Mission should let me ask for one favor she is willing to grant. If this countdown really is a threat, I may need her help.

Chen Ge tapped Zhang Ya’s name. Even after everything he had experienced, the crimson interface made his courage waver.The problem is that her idea of affection is terrifying. I should probably avoid encouraging it more than necessary.

Not everyone could receive a specter’s devotion with equanimity. Chen Ge closed the page, and even the ordinary morning air felt friendlier.The Bloody Heart Mission is my last resort. If another number appears tonight, I will stop waiting and do it.

With that decision made, Chen Ge finally allowed exhaustion to catch up with him and fell asleep.

Xu Wan arrived around eight. Chen Ge left the Haunted House in her hands while he used Uncle Xu’s loan to purchase more cameras. The break-in had made the building’s blind spots impossible to ignore, and the upgrade also satisfied one of the black phone’s Daily Missions.

Installers arrived that afternoon. Under Chen Ge’s supervision, they placed cameras throughout the Haunted House until most major corridors and entrances were covered. With money running low, he added only a basic audio monitor to the Minghun scenario and postponed the rest of the upgrades.

At seven that evening, after the final test, the black phone vibrated with a mission-completion notice.

“Congratulations on completing the Easy Mission. Reward obtained: Background Music—Wedding Dress!

“Note: Wedding Dress is the perfect accompaniment to Minghun. Minghun’s Scream Factor has increased to 1 Star!”

Chen Ge blinked at the notification. Minghun had originally rated only half a star. A single music track had doubled its Scream Factor.

This must be even more unsettling than Black Friday.

Curious, he played the new track. It was completely different from Black Friday’s slow, creeping dread. Wedding Dress blended the ceremonial qualities of wedding music with the solemnity of a funeral lament, creating something uncanny from the very first notes.

It fits Minghun almost too well. I should use it carefully instead of blasting it all day.

He saved Wedding Dress to his phone, then went upstairs to finish cleaning the third floor.

He still could not afford cleaners, so he worked through the evening with the dolls tucked safely in his pockets, removing the remaining mirror fragments and tidying the scenario. By the time he finished, midnight was approaching.

He began checking the mirrors, waiting to see whether the mysterious countdown would continue.
